title: Is Decentralized Finance Actually Decentralized? An Interdisciplinary Framework Integrating Network Theory, Agent-Based Simulation, and Longitudinal Evidence from Aave, GHO Issuance, and Cross-Chain Expansion
abstract: arXiv:2206.08401v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Decentralized finance (DeFi) can broaden access while leaving activity, network position, and infrastructure concentrated. We develop a four-dimensional framework for participation, activity distribution, structural position, and infrastructure dependence, integrating network theory, theorem-consistent agent-based simulation, and longitudinal analysis of 1,956,216 Aave V3 Pool events. We study GHO issuance on Ethereum (15 July 2023) and its first cross-chain expansion to Aave's existing Arbitrum market (2 July 2024). Excluding each activation week, mean weekly active position-holder addresses increased by 91.0% around Ethereum issuance and 1.7% around Arbitrum expansion, while activity concentration fell by 31.5% on Ethereum but rose by 58.1% on Arbitrum. translated_title: 去中心化金融真的去中心化吗？一个整合网络理论、基于代理的模拟以及来自Aave、GHO发行和跨链扩展的纵向证据的跨学科框架
translated_abstract: 去中心化金融（DeFi）可以拓宽准入渠道，同时却使活动、网络位置和基础设施保持集中。我们开发了一个四维框架，涵盖参与度、活动分布、结构位置和基础设施依赖，整合了网络理论、定理一致的基于代理的模拟以及对1,956,216个Aave V3 Pool事件的纵向分析。我们研究了GHO在以太坊上的发行（2023年7月15日）及其首次跨链扩展到Aave现有的Arbitrum市场（2024年7月2日）。排除每个激活周后，以太坊发行期间平均每周活跃持仓者地址增加了91.0%，而Arbitrum扩展期间增加了1.7%；同时，活动集中度在以太坊上下降了31.5%，但在Arbitrum上上升了58.1%。在共同的2024年日历上，Arbitrum-Gnosis双重差分风格的变化为对数参与度+1.9833，持仓者事件HHI为-0.01842。基于规则的模拟复现了上述分析结果。
tldr: 本文提出一个跨学科四维框架，结合网络理论、代理模拟和Aave的纵向数据，发现DeFi在参与度上扩展但活动集中度在跨链场景中可能加剧，揭示了去中心化与集中化并存的复杂现实。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interdisciplinary four-dimensional framework integrating network theory, agent-based simulation, and longitudinal Aave data, revealing that DeFi expands participation but may intensify activity concentration in cross-chain contexts, highlighting the complex coexistence of decentralization and centralization.
